releases.title: God Mode is now Global Admin
releases.text: Same screens, new name. The page is now GlobalAdmin.html; old links and bookmarks still work and open it automatically. Log in with the licence key GLOBAL_ADMIN (GODMODE still works for now).
releases.who: Global Admin (formerly God Mode) and System Admin users

releases.title: Step-by-step tenant onboarding
releases.text: Start onboarding (Tenants) replaces the long Deploy form for new clients. It asks about employees (fixed or seasonal), modules, extras and Demo / Setup mode, shows the once-off and monthly cost, and saves at every step so you can finish later. Each quote shows its status and what is still missing, with a full history of who did what.
releases.who: Global Admin and System Admin users

releases.title: Billing options and BP reseller links
releases.text: Finance can choose which billing methods BPs may offer (fixed, peak, actual, average, seasonal) under TNA Admin → Onboarding billing options. In System Users you can link a BP user to a reseller so they only see that reseller's tenants and quotes. Only System Admin marks a quote Ready to deploy and deploys it.

releases.title: Global Admin has a new look
releases.text: Global Admin and System Admin now match the Support desk: a cleaner menu grouped by area, a profile button (top right) with Light / Dark mode and Log out, and easier-to-read cards, tables and pop-ups. Everything else works exactly as before.
releases.who: Global Admin and System Admin users

releases.title: Upload your logo
releases.text: You can now upload the company logo under Global Settings → Branding. It shows at the top of the Global Admin and System Admin menu for every Global Admin user. Every upload and removal is recorded in the Audit Logs.

releases.title: Guided tours in Global Admin
releases.text: The ? button (bottom right) now works here too: replay the tour, tour the screen you are on, or follow a how-to guide such as Set up a new tenant.
releases.who: Global Admin and System Admin users
